facts.fact: Newsmada reports the Ministry of Digital Development (MNDPT) held a validation workshop on a draft decree (projet de decree) on electronic signature and interoperability, which would create a dedicated interoperability regulatory framework with the Unite de Gouvernance Digitale (UGD) and a national interoperability committee; no date for the workshop is given, so the article's published date is used.
facts.system: Draft decree on electronic signature and interoperability
